<thought>To locate the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the nitro‑to‑amine reduction, I’ll query the template catalog for reactions that break a nitro group and form a primary amine. Using a simple nitro‑benzene SMILES as a representative molecule will let the search return relevant templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)[N+](=O)[O-]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
